summary: Self-contained HTML template that renders coldstart's 1200×630 social media preview card. The design combines Newsreader serif for the headline (48px), JetBrains Mono for the kicker (uppercase, cyan, letterspaced), and IBM Plex Sans for muted sub-lines. The headline uses dual accent colors — frost cyan (#4fbfe0) on 'scratch' and warm amber (#ef9448) on 'session' — matching the live homepage hero styling. The snowflake SVG mark is inlined from SvgDefs.astro's path definition but rendered in cyan (#4fbfe0). Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts over HTTPS; the container is exactly 1200×630 with dark background (#070a11) and a bottom gradient rule (cyan → amber). Rendered to PNG by generate-og.sh.
